Source inspection shows that numerically equivalent spellings still miss the deferral check.
Request changes for the uncovered alias behavior. Retain the reporting regression as a p2 follow-up. Reviewed the complete one-file diff. The pinned head is two commits behind origin/integration. Review used source, implementer test reports and existing CI evidence.
